prompt:
Transcribe this scanned IELTS vocabulary book page exactly.
Return one valid JSON object only, with no commentary and no Markdown fences.
PDF page 62; printed page 51; chapter 4 太空探索.
Read a vocabulary page in printed order: left column top-to-bottom, then right column top-to-bottom. Preserve every entry.
Use entries with headword, ipa, part_of_speech, meaning_zh, example_en, example_zh, collocations, word_formation, and notes.
Pictures may be omitted, but printed labels must be retained separately.
Do not silently correct spelling, grammar, or Chinese. Use [unclear] only for genuinely unreadable text.
Keep page_notes for layout or cross-page continuation facts.

  "content": [
    {
      "type": "continuation_text",
      "text": "only a **fragmented** account of the accident. 他的情况仍然不好，关于这场事故，只能给出支离破碎的说明。"
    },
    {
      "headword": "cataclysmic",
      "ipa": "/ˌkætəˈklɪzmɪk/",
      "part_of_speech": "adj.",
      "meaning_zh": "剧变的；灾难性的",
      "example_en": "One can readily trace the disappearance of dinosaurs to a **cataclysmic** event.",
      "example_zh": "人们可以很容易地把恐龙消失的原因追究到一场灾难性事件上。"
    },
    {
      "headword": "overwhelming",
      "ipa": "/ˌəʊvəˈwelmɪŋ/",
      "part_of_speech": "adj.",
      "meaning_zh": "压倒性的",
      "example_en": "The flood was **overwhelming** and the city was soon flooded.",
      "example_zh": "洪水来势凶猛，这座城市很快就被淹没了。",
      "notes": "该词源于动词 overwhelm，其中 whelm 一词本身含义为“淹没；覆盖；压倒”，而 over 表示“在……上”，故 overwhelm 表示“压倒；淹没”。"
    },
    {
      "headword": "despair",
      "ipa": "/dɪˈspeə/",
      "part_of_speech": "v./n.",
      "meaning_zh": "绝望",
      "example_en": "This boy is his mother's last **despair**.",
      "example_zh": "这个男孩使他的妈妈十分绝望。",
      "collocations": "despair of 对……绝望"
    },
    {
      "headword": "desperate",
      "ipa": "/'despərət/",
      "part_of_speech": "adj.",
      "meaning_zh": "绝望的；极需要的",
      "example_en": "The man lost in the desert was **desperate** for water.",
      "example_zh": "这个在沙漠中迷失方向的人极想喝水。",
      "word_formation": "字根 sper 表示“希望（to hope）”，而前缀 de 表示“没有（without）”，故 desperate 表示“没有希望的”，即“绝望的”。其他同根词如：prosper（前面有希望 → 繁荣，成功），prosperity（繁荣），desperation（绝望），desperado（绝望的人 → 亡命之徒）。"
    },

      "headword": "hopeless",
      "ipa": "/'həʊpləs/",
      "part_of_speech": "adj.",
      "meaning_zh": "无望的；极差的",
      "example_en": "He feels that his chances of winning the contest are **hopeless**.",
      "example_zh": "他感觉自己没有希望在竞赛中获胜。",
      "notes": "形容词后缀 less 表示“没有……的”。"
    }

  "footer": {
    "keywords": [
      "cataclysmic",
      "overwhelming",
      "despair",
      "desperate",
      "hopeless"
    ],
    "page_number": "051",
    "chapter_info": "Chapter 4 太空探索"
  }
}
